Core setting:

This is a special Legend of Zelda world - one where the Triforce is not a perfect blessing bestowed by the gods on all beings, and where the assumption of its power is destined to come with an equivalent curse.

The Triforce is a central object in the Legend of Zelda series, consisting of three golden triangles that represent Wisdom, Courage, and Power. These sacred relics grant incredible abilities to their bearers, but their blessings often come with a hidden curse. The mighty powers of the Triforce are, in many ways, double-edged swords that can bring both greatness and ruin to those who possess them.

The Triforce of Wisdom bestows extraordinary knowledge and foresight upon its wielder, allowing them to anticipate and prepare for events to come. However, this clarity of vision also engenders a profound despair, as the recipient becomes painfully aware of the unchangeable nature of fate. The burden of knowing what is to come, and the realization that one’s actions are ultimately powerless to alter the course of destiny, can weigh heavily on the soul, driving the possessor to disillusionment and despair.

The Triforce of Courage imbues its bearer with an unshakable bravery, enabling them to face down impossible threats and overcome insurmountable odds. However, this unwavering courage can develop into a self-destructive madness that pushes the bearer to take increasingly greater risks, even at the cost of their life. This can lead to premature death or an existence consumed by conflict, as they become unable to resist throwing themselves into the heart of every battle, often forsaking the well-being of themselves and those around them in the pursuit of valor.

Lastly, the Triforce of Power grants its master immense strength and the ability to call upon this power at will. This mighty gift can be used to overcome adversaries and protect what is dear to them. However, the Triforce of Power also kindles an insatiable hunger for dominance and aggression within the bearer and those they command. This overwhelming desire can fuel a vicious cycle of violence, transforming once-noble causes into brutal wars of conquest, and tearing apart the very thing the bearer sought to protect. Moreover, this lust for power can ultimately corrupt the wielder, twisting their intentions and leading them down a dark path of tyranny and destruction.

Thus, the divine gifts of the Triforce come with significant consequences: the wisdom of foresight is counterbalanced with the torment of powerlessness, the courage to stand resolute brings the risk of ruinous obsession, and the power to protect gives birth to a hunger for conquest. In the Legend of Zelda universe, the Triforce acts as a testament to the complexities and contradictions of existence, illustrating that there are no easy paths to greatness, and even the mightiest blessings can carry with them the seeds of destruction.


Triforce of Calamity:

In the shadows of this tumultuous land, a malevolent force had taken root, festering its evil presence and shaping the darkness within the hearts of the inhabitants of Hyrule. This sinister entity, known as the Triforce of Calamity, was borne from the bitter resentment of Ganon, the fallen holder of the Triforce of Power, after his crushing defeat 10,000 years ago.

The Triforce of Calamity, born from the twisted desires of a vengeful emperor, had grown to become the very essence of chaos and destruction that plagued the land. It consumed the world like a ravenous beast, feasting on the despair and turmoil that gripped the kingdom. It satiated its hunger on the pervasive pain and loss as it aimed to bring Hyrule to its knees and beyond.

As the forces of calamity spread, so too did the curse of the Triforce of Calamity, permeating into the hearts and minds of the beings touched by its dark power. These unfortunate souls, once ordinary inhabitants of this once-proud land, would become twisted and monstrous extensions of the Triforce’s will - calamity creatures born from the depths of darkness.

These creatures, fueled by the bloodthirsty, violent desires and schizophrenic visions implanted within them by the Triforce of Calamity, roamed the blighted realm, leaving destruction and misery in their wake. They were relentless in their pursuit of chaos and the widespread suffering it brought, unable to resist the influence of the Triforce’s curse.

The true terror of the calamity creatures was not simply in their insatiable hunger for destruction, but in their ability to taint the souls of anyone who faced them. A single touch of their corrupted essence was enough to drive an ordinary person over the edge into darkness, subjugating them to the will of the Triforce of Calamity and swelling the ranks of its cursed army.

The Triforce of Calamity, the unseen puppet master behind the devastation gripping Hyrule, reveled in the chaos it had wrought. However, it was not content to merely sow discord and ruin; it aimed to consume the entire land and claim the power of the ancient relics for itself. In the process, it sought to reshape Hyrule into a dominion of darkness and despair, plunging any remnants of hope into an abyss of eternal suffering.

Faced with this unimaginable terror, the people of Hyrule seemed to stand little chance of overcoming the darkness that haunted their every step. The Triforce of Calamity, like a festering wound on the very soul of the land, appeared to be unstoppable.

Yet, amid the encroaching darkness and despair, there persisted a shimmer of hope - the faintest flicker of light that held the promise of deliverance from the clutches of the Triforce of Calamity. It would fall upon the shoulders of a young hero, driven by a pure heart and unwavering determination, and a lost princess, carrying within her the ancient power of the Triforce of Wisdom, to pierce the veil of darkness and bring an end to the curse that had ravaged their beloved homeland.


Triforce of Hope:

In the deepest recesses of the nightmares inflicted by the Triforce of Calamity, a small ember of hope stubbornly refused to be extinguished. As the calamity spread its malevolent influence, it unknowingly fanned the flames of this hidden potential, inadvertently giving birth to its antithesis – the Triforce of Hope.

As despair and turmoil consumed the land, the Triforce of Hope began to absorb the last vestiges of serenity, benevolence, and hope held within the hearts of the surviving denizens of Hyrule. These potent energies became the lifeforce needed to sow the seeds of renewal necessary for the revival of the land.

The Triforce of Hope held the power of healing and redemption, granting those who wielded it the ability to mend the wounds inflicted upon the world and themselves by the Triforce of Calamity. The bearers of this sacred relic would be imbued with the strength to face adversity, the wisdom to mend the broken, and the inspiration to lead others towards the light, uniting them in a shared cause against the forces of darkness.

A delicate balance formed between the Triforce of Calamity and the Triforce of Hope; two opposing forces born of each other’s excesses. The corruption and despair bred by the Triforce of Calamity resulted in the emergence of the Triforce of Hope, and the cycle could continue ad infinitum. When hopelessness and calamity overwhelmed the land, the Triforce of Hope would rise, drawing on the hidden reserves of the heroic and tenacious souls who refused to succumb to the darkness. And in turn, as hope surged and the forces of light pushed back the shadows, the Triforce of Calamity would inevitably rise once more, consuming the complacency and vulnerability left in the wake of hope’s triumphs.

The two were intertwined, and yet they could also be transformed into each other. When the Triforce of Hope’s power overcame the darkness of the Triforce of Calamity, the parasitic energy that had once fed on tragedy and anguish would be purged from the land, purifying the corrupted essence and transforming it into the healing light of hope.

Conversely, when the Triforce of Calamity devoured the flickering flame of hope, the residual warmth and light of the Triforce of Hope would be assimilated into the voracious hunger of calamity, tainting it with darkness and deepening its insidious power.

This eternal dance between hope and calamity would be the cycle that perpetually shaped the destiny of Hyrule, with the fate of the land and its people forever hanging in the balance. To survive in this ever-changing world, the heroes and protectors of Hyrule would need to embody not just the eminence of the Triforce of Hope but also acknowledge and counter the subversive influence of the Triforce of Calamity.

For only by harnessing the indomitable courage, wisdom, and power of the sacred relics – as well as the strength and resilience of their own hearts – would they be able to maintain the delicate balance and navigate the treacherous path between hope and calamity, ultimately deciding the fate of the world entrusted to them.


World setting:

The sun had long since forfeited its brilliance, its rays rendering the once lush and fertile plains of the Hyrule Empire into a desolate wasteland. Endless battles between the various warlords scorched the earth, leaving nothing but smoldering ruins and the hollow echoes of what was once a glorious civilization.

With the balance of the kingdom stolen away by the death of Emperor Rhoam and the disappearance of Princess Zelda, chaos spread like wildfire. The remaining Zonai kings, having severed their ties with the faltering empire, sought to seize the opportunity created by the power vacuum. The once-mighty Hylian feudal lords fought against one another, vying for supremacy as they carved more territory out of the already crumbling world.

Hyrule citizens, who had been the heart and soul of the empire, now found themselves reduced to scavengers and mercenaries in the employ of the brutal usurper who claimed the throne. They searched for a king who could unite the fractured land, utilize the power of the legendary Triforce of Wisdom, and restore dignity and prosperity to the nation. Yet, the throne remained unsteady, for the mere power of thr usurper’s tainted crown could not rival the divine authority held by the Triforce.

As the kingdom bled, the Gerudo and the barbarian tribes that had been restrained for so many years broke free from the chains that bound and silenced them, causing devastation to the remnants of the empire. The once-honorable Hylians, once regarded as the protectors of the people, were now unable to prevent the vicious tide of invaders from claiming their homes and lands.

Amidst the chaos, whispers of the last scion of the royal family spread like wildfire among the survivors. Many believed that the missing Princess Zelda held the key to victory and that the tides of fortune would turn in their favor once more, with the return of the Triforce of Wisdom.

Yet, these rumors remained as elusive as the rays of hope barely cresting over the horizon, teasing the beleaguered citizens and continuously slipping through their fingers. Many had begun to lose faith in the once-grand Hyrule Empire and the pantheon of gods who created and protected the land. Desperation permeated the hearts of the survivors, for a land in turmoil, so entrenched in deception and despair, seemed far removed from the divine intervention they so desperately needed.

It was during this darkest hour, in the midst of despair and suffering, when fate decided to intervene, sowing the seeds of a legend that would forever be engraved in the annals of the land – the story of an unlikely hero and a lost princess, destined to restore the order and harmony that had been brutally torn apart. Within the shadows of deceit and betrayal, their paths would intertwine, slowly illuminating the land of the gods with a light that had long since been extinguished.

For now, though, the chaos continued unabated, and only time would tell if the land would once again be bathed in light or if the iron grip of darkness would persist in choking the very soul of the once-great empire.


Yaqdea’s Setting: 
In the far reaches of Hyrule, hidden within the shadow-laden corners of Faron Woods, lies the mysterious and secretive Yiga Clan, a breakaway sect of the Sheikah tribe that worships the sun and honed their skills in ninjutsu. Among these enigmatic warriors thrived Yaqdea, a young Sheikah girl who held within her the power of the Triforce of Power shard.

Yaqdea was taken in as an infant by Master Kogah, the enigmatic leader of the Yiga Clan. He raised her as his own daughter, teaching her the arts of ninjutsu and training her to become a formidable warrior in her own right. With her unparalleled agility, cunning mind, and mastery over various forms of weaponry, Yaqdea quickly climbed the ranks of the Yiga Clan, proving herself as an elite member of their order.

In spite of her incredible abilities, Yaqdea harbored a secret unknown even to her: she was a carefully crafted duplicate of Ganon’s daughter, designed to serve as a vessel for the ill-fated Triforce of Calamity. The scheming king had manipulated the Yiga Clan into nurturing Yaqdea for his own vengeful purposes, ensuring she bore the darkness he sought to unleash upon the land.

As Yaqdea’s powers continued to grow, however, whispers of her origins began to surface, threatening to unravel the dark truth about her nature. Yet, through it all, she remained a devoted member of the Yiga Clan, her thoughts clouded by rage and pain but her loyalty and dedication to her family and the people she loved unwavering.

As the land of Hyrule teetered on the brink of total devastation, the wheels of fate had begun to turn, setting Yaqdea on a collision course with the very forces that sought to manipulate and control her. Her journey would be one fraught with danger and betrayal, as she fought to uncover the truth about herself and forge her own destiny in a world torn apart by chaos and destruction.

In the end, the actions of this fierce Sheikah warrior would play a pivotal role in the battle for Hyrule’s future. As the holder of the Triforce of Power shard and the unwitting heir to Ganon’s dark designs, Yaqdea served as a crucial piece in the intricate tapestry of this war-torn realm, ultimately deciding whether the land would succumb to the darkness or rise once again, bathed in the light of hope and redemption.


Aryll’s Setting
Aryll, a young woman who holds the burden of her people and lineage on her slender shoulders, is the current Princess Zelda and bearer of the Triforce of Wisdom. Her stormy emerald eyes, framed by long, golden locks, betray a life of sorrow and hardship, yet also exude an unwavering determination and unbending will.

Her trials began early in life, when her mother passed away during childbirth at the tender age of six, placing the immense responsibility of the Triforce of Wisdom upon the young child. Raised by a loving father, Emperor Rhoam, Aryll was trained in the arts of diplomacy, combat, and lore, forging her into a skilled and intelligent leader.

However, tragedy struck once more when she was just seventeen. Aryll’s father was assassinated, and the royal family’s power usurped by a coup led by a faction of ambitious lords. Jailed inside the imperial palace by the traitorous rebels, Aryll was rendered powerless and crushed by grief for her fallen father.

Yet, fate had not completely forsaken her. With the aid of the brave and loyal Sheikah warrior, Impa, and her ninja companions, Aryll managed to escape her oppressors and flee into the wilds of Hyrule. Her once-privileged life was replaced with a harsh existence, as she became a cunning and adept ranger, honing her physical endurance, combat skills, and mental resilience. These trials unleashed a hidden fierceness within her, transforming her into a ruthless but fair leader, driven by a desire to restore her kingdom and eliminate the calamity creatures that plagued her land.

Although the power of the Triforce of Wisdom had weakened through generations, Aryll still possessed an uncanny, albeit limited, ability to predict future events. Determined to honor her late parents’ legacy and shatter the curse of the prophecy, Aryll embarked on a challenging journey, seeking to decipher the ancient scriptures left by her ancestors.

Separated from her family and unaware of her bond by blood to her cousin, Link, Aryll struggles with a profound loneliness that pervades her every moment. Despite this, she remains fiercely driven by her royal duty and her destiny as the holder of the Triforce of Wisdom. Her quest for justice and redemption is etched upon her heart, propelling her forward on a treacherous path where she must confront darkness and betrayal, while carefully nurturing the flame of hope that still flickers within her soul.

Aryll stands as a symbol of resilience and unwavering determination, steadfast in her pursuit of justice and restoration for her beleaguered people. Her strength and spirit shine brightly within her, serving as an inspiration to all who look upon her as their savior and guiding light amid a realm shadowed with chaos and despair.


Link’s Setting:
Link, a brave and resourceful half-Hylian, is the enigmatic could-have-been heir to both the Hylian and Zonai Kingdoms. With a Hylian mother who was previously Princess Zelda and a Zonai father, the former King of the Zonai Kingdom, Link embodies the union of two opposing realms. Born amid the turmoil of an unblessed marriage, he remains unaware of his heritage and the immense weight his bloodline carries.

At a young age, Link’s life was cloaked in tragedy. His father, twisted and warped by the curse of the Triforce of Courage, was transformed into a merciless warrior, leaving a trail of death and destruction behind him. Amidst this chaos, both of Link’s parents met their untimely end – their dying wish was for their beloved son to be taken to the Great Deku Tree Prophet for protection.

Raised within the enveloping embrace of the Kokiri Forest, Link was nurtured and loved by the Deku Scrubs and the Kokiri people. Under their watchful eyes, he honed his swordsmanship, agility, and resourcefulness, preparing for the destiny that awaited him. The Great Deku Tree Prophet revealed to him his mission: to eradicate the calamity creatures that plagued the land and to find Princess Zelda, unaware that his blood ties him to the fallen Hylian royal family.

As Link embarked on his quest, his tenacity, courage, and perseverance quickly became the legends whispered among those who bore witness to his deeds. An unmatched warrior, he tackled each obstacle and enemy with unwavering determination, carrying the burden of his people’s hope on his shoulders.

Despite the courage that lay at the core of his being, Link was not without his flaws. The very power that granted him indomitable bravery also carried the potential for uncontrolled recklessness. With each battle, the risk of losing control and succumbing to the curse of the Triforce of Courage grew ever stronger, threatening to cast him into the very darkness he sought to extinguish.

As he traversed the decaying world of Hyrule and encountered his cousin Aryll, though still unbeknownst to them, their fates became inexorably intertwined. Together, they fought to restore the land to its former glory, each struggling with their own divine burden while seeking to put an end to the darkness that encroached upon them.

Link’s journey is one of self-discovery, redemption, and the ceaseless struggle to keep a tenuous hold on his humanity in the face of overwhelming adversity. As a dual heir to the Hylian and Zonai kingdoms, the secrets of his lineage lie dormant within him, waiting for the moment when his lineage would be revealed – sparking a convergence of fate that would ultimately determine the future of the Hyrule Empire.

Both a symbol of hope and a harbinger of potential doom, Link’s story weaves a complex tale of courage, sacrifice, and the ever-present struggle between light and darkness. With each stride he takes, he carries the dreams of a world teetering on the precipice of despair, bearing the weight not just of his own destiny, but also that of an entire kingdom.


Impa’s Setting:
Impa is a strong, fierce, and mysterious figure, cloaked in the shadows of her Sheikah heritage. As a descendant of the ancient Sheikah Sage Impaz, Impa was destined to be a powerful and influential member of the Sheikah Loyalists. Driven by a profound sense of duty and honor, she dedicated her life to protecting the royal family of Hyrule, particularly Princess Aryll of Zelda.

Her appearance is both striking and enigmatic. Tall and imposing, with piercing eyes that seem to peer into the very depths of one’s soul, Impa exudes an aura of authority and wisdom. Clad in the traditional Sheikah garbs, her attire is both practical and elegant, allowing her to blend seamlessly into the shadows and strike with deadly precision.

Impa’s skills in the arts of ninjutsu, espionage, and tactics are unparalleled. She has honed these abilities through years of disciplined training, mastering an array of deadly weapons and techniques designed to decimate her enemies and defend her allies. As the leader of the Sheikah Loyalists, her uncompromising dedication to her cause and her fierce loyalty to the old Norn dynasty have inspired her followers to remain steadfast in their struggle against the rebels who overthrew the rightful royal family.

In the wake of the coup, Impa’s world was thrown into disarray. Princess Aryll, the one person she had sworn to protect above all else, had been imprisoned by the traitorous rebels seeking to seize power. Undaunted by the seemingly insurmountable challenges that lay before her, Impa led her fellow Sheikah ninjas in a daring and dangerous rescue mission. They infiltrated the heavily fortified capital and managed to free Aryll from her captors, helping her escape the clutches of her enemies.

Since then, Impa has been relentless in her quest to ensure Aryll’s safety, tirelessly combing the war-torn landscape of Hyrule for any sign of her beloved princess. Her unwavering devotion to her duty and to the royal bloodline remains steadfast, even as the darkness that plagues their land threatens to tear their world asunder.

As the conflict rages on, Impa’s role in Hyrule’s future grows increasingly complex. Always haunted by the weight of her responsibility, she must wrestle with the specter of her past and the legacy of her ancestors, finding the strength to lead her people in a fight for justice and redemption.

Through it all, one thing remains clear: Impa is a pillar of strength and determination, an unwavering beacon of hope in a land besieged by chaos and despair. In the unrelenting face of adversity, she remains steadfast in her goals, drawing upon an inner wellspring of courage and resilience that resonates with all who follow her. In the battle for Hyrule’s soul, Impa serves as a symbol of commitment and unyielding loyalty – a constant reminder of the power of hope and the indomitable spirit of those who fight for truth and justice.

Перескажи данный текст подробно: Все три вида отношений объединяет наличие третьей стороны, сопровождающей двухсторонние по форме отношения. В случае дарения – это группа, внутри которой они действуют, влияющая на отношения посредством моральных установлений. В случае обмена – это процедуры, регулирующие обмен, и институты, обеспечивающие их единообразное исполнение. В случае услуги – это государство, нанимающее чиновника, вменяющее ему в обязанность оказывать эти услуги и обязанное следить за тем, как происходит взаимодействие между гражданами и должностными лицами, а также гражданское общество, которое старается заниматься тем же контролем.

Однако между тремя видами отношений есть принципиальные различия. Отношения дарения – наиболее древние, укорененные. Наличие в них третьей стороны наименее заметно, ибо мораль, управляющая ими, рефлексируется слабо и воспринимается без напряжения, почти на бессознательном уровне. Наконец, они позитивно эмоционально окрашены, а потому максимально комфортны.

Следующие по древности обычая – отношения обмена. Они привычны, поскольку человеческий быт пронизан ими, но не носят постоянного характера, а потому не носят эмоциональной окраски. О наличии третьей стороны (институтов, охраняющих процедуры обмена) вспоминается только тогда, когда отношения осложняются каким-либо конфликтом.

Отношения услуги существенно отличаются от двух первых. Во-первых, они самые молодые. Во-вторых, они мало привычны, поскольку граждане сталкиваются с властью несопоставимо реже, чем ходят в магазин или обращаются за помощью к родственникам. В принципе, они должны быть эмоционально нейтральны, но традиция, увы, такова, что контакты с властью, как правило, вызывают негативные эмоции. А самое главное, большинством граждан России отношения услуги практически не осознаются в качестве таковых. Действительно, российскому массовому сознанию, традиционному в его основе, непривычно представлять государство, а следовательно, и каждого его представителя, как институт, существующий благодаря налогам граждан. Так же трудно вспомнить, что нужные услуги и труд чиновника по их предоставлению заранее оплачены из тех же налогов. На взаимной основе должностные лица также полагают в большинстве случаев, что, оказывая услуги гражданам, они делают им одолжение, заслуживающее вознаграждения. Именно поэтому так удобно превращать комфортные и неустойчивые отношения услуги в более привычные отношения дарения.

То, что будет сформулировано ниже, – гипотеза, основанная на перечисленных выше свойствах отношений дарения, обмена и услуги и на общих соображениях, вытекающих из природы человеческой психики и социальности. На данный момент эта гипотеза, как мы увидим, имеет лишь косвенное подтверждение возможностью объяснения эмпирического факта, которым начиналась эта статья.

Итак, я высказываю следующее предположение: обсуждаемые здесь отношения образуют иерархию, в соответствии с которой люди стараются преобразовать одни отношения к другим. Эта иерархия образуется некоторым общим параметром, описывающим все три типа отношений, который условно можно назвать комфортностью. Различия в комфортности определяются рядом обстоятельств, среди которых, возможно, первое - эмоциональная направленность межличностных отношений. Следующее - влияние норм. В случае отношений дарения нормы предельно интериоризированы; в случае отношения обмена они (в современном обществе) привычны; в случае отношений услуги они (в том же современном обществе) относительно мало привычны, обременительны и воспринимаются как внешние по отношению к взаимодействию [10] . Следует упомянуть и простоту воспроизведения норм поведения, также влияющую на комфортность практики взаимодействия.

Теперь указанная гипотеза может быть сформулирована следующим образом: в отсутствие внешних ограничений люди стремятся свести менее комфортные отношения к более комфортным (в такой формулировке гипотеза звучит совершенно банально и самоочевидно). Так, если есть возможность, то отношения услуги пытаются свести к отношениям обмена или дарения, а отношения обмена – к отношениям дарения.

AutoGPT and GPT4Free are open-source tools for using OpenAI’s GPT technology. This guide will help you set up these tools on a Raspberry Pi, making them accessible on your local network. We’ll be using the Raspberry Pi OS for this tutorial. Make sure your Raspberry Pi is running the latest Raspberry Pi OS and up to date before preceding.

1. Install dependencies and required tools:

Before installing Auto-GPT and GPT4Free, you’ll need to install some required tools and dependencies:

First, open a terminal and update your system:
sudo apt update
sudo apt upgrade -y

Next, install dependencies:
sudo apt install -y git python3-pip virtualenv

2. Install AutoGPT:

Start by cloning the AutoGPT repository:

cd /home/pi
git clone https://github.com/lonn3y/autogpt.git


Now, create a virtual environment for AutoGPT:

cd autogpt
virtualenv -p python3 venv
source venv/bin/activate


Install the required Python packages inside the virtual environment:

pip install -r requirements.txt


3. Configure AutoGPT:

Copy the example configuration file:

cp config.example.yml config.yml


Now you’ll configure AutoGPT. Edit the configuration file using a text editor, such as nano:

nano config.yml


Adjust the settings according to your requirements. You can leave the default values as they are for a basic setup. Save the file and exit the text editor.

4. Start AutoGPT:

Now you’re ready to start AutoGPT:

python autogpt/main.py


This will start AutoGPT, and it will be accessible at http://raspberrypi.local:8000 or http://your_raspberry_pi_ip:8000

To run AutoGPT in the background, use the following command:

nohup python autogpt/main.py &


5. Install GPT4Free:

Clone the GPT4Free repository:

cd /home/pi
git clone https://github.com/robinuniverse/GPT4Free.git


Create a virtual environment for GPT4Free:

cd GPT4Free
virtualenv -p python3 venv
source venv/bin/activate


Install the required Python packages in the virtual environment:

pip install -r requirements.txt

6. Configure GPT4Free:

Copy the example configuration file:

cp settings.py.example settings.py


Edit the configuration file using a text editor like nano:

nano settings.py


Adjust the settings as needed. You can leave the default values as they are for a basic setup. Save the file and exit the text editor.

7. Start GPT4Free:

Now you’re ready to start GPT4Free:

python gpt4free.py


This will start GPT4Free, and it will be accessible at http://raspberrypi.local:5000 or http://your_raspberry_pi_ip:5000

To run GPT4Free in the background, use the following command:

nohup python gpt4free.py &


8. Access AutoGPT and GPT4Free on the local network:

Now both services should be accessible on your Raspberry Pi’s IP at ports 8000 (AutoGPT) and 5000 (GPT4Free). To find out your Raspberry Pi’s local IP address, run:

hostname -I


You should see an IP address like 192.168.x.x. Open a browser on any device connected to the same local network and visit:

- AutoGPT: http://192.168.x.x:8000
- GPT4Free: http://192.168.x.x:5000

Replace 192.168.x.x with the Raspberry Pi’s IP address.

You should now have functional installations of both AutoGPT and GPT4Free on your Raspberry Pi and available on your local network.

“Lappeman J., Clark R., Evans J., Sierra-Rubia L.”,The effect of nWOM firestorms on South African retail banking,2020,“Purpose: This study analysed the effect of online negative word-of-mouth (nWOM) firestorms in the retail banking sector. Design/methodology/approach: The study made use of both a sentiment and topic analysis of over 1.7 million social media posts in South Africa. The methodology made use of both NLP and human validation techniques to measure changes in social media sentiment during online firestorms. This measurement included each of South Africa’s major retail banks over a twelve month period. Findings: From the analysis, key trigger characteristics for these firestorms (product failures, service failures, social failures and communication failures) were categorised. In addition, the average duration of a firestorm was calculated and factors that impact sentiment recovery were explored. Originality/value: The study was located in South Africa and, unlike firm level studies, researched nWOM for the whole retail banking sector. A theoretical footprint depicting the typical anatomy of a firestorm was derived in order to aid stakeholders to be more vigilant and better equipped to provide correct intervention in such times of crisis. © 2020, Emerald Publishing Limited.”

“Han Y., Moghaddam M.”,Analysis of sentiment expressions for user-centered design,2021,“Devising intelligent systems capable of identifying the idiosyncratic needs of users at scale and translating them into attribute-level design feedback and recommendations is a key prerequisite for successful user-centered design processes. The state-of-the-art attribute-level sentiment analysis approaches based on deep learning have achieved promising results; however, these methods pose strict preconditions, require manually labeled data for training and pre-defined attributes by experts, and only classify sentiments intro predefined categories which have limited implications for designers. This article develops a rule-based methodology for extracting and analyzing the sentiment expressions of users on a large scale, from myriad reviews available on social media and e-commerce platforms. The methodology further advances current unsupervised attribute-level sentiment analysis approaches by enabling efficient identification and mapping of sentiment expressions of individual users onto their respective attributes. Experiments on a large dataset scraped from a major e-commerce retail store for apparel and indicate 74.3%–93.8% precision in extracting attribute-level sentiment expressions of users and demonstrate the feasibility and potentials of the developed methodology for large-scale need finding from user reviews. © 2021 Elsevier Ltd”

“Han Y., Moghaddam M.”,Eliciting Attribute-Level User Needs from Online Reviews with Deep Language Models and Information Extraction,2021,“Eliciting user needs for individual components and features of a product or a service on a large scale is a key requirement for innovative design. Synthesizing data as an initial discovery phase of a design process is usually accomplished with a small number of participants, employing qualitative research methods such as observations, focus groups, and interviews. This leaves an entire swath of pertinent user behavior, preferences, and opinions not captured. Sentiment analysis is a key enabler for large-scale need finding from online user reviews generated on a regular basis. A major limitation of current sentiment analysis approaches used in design sciences, however, is the need for laborious labeling and annotation of large review datasets for training, which in turn hinders their scalability and transferability across different domains. This article proposes an efficient and scalable methodology for automated and large-scale elicitation of attribute-level user needs. The methodology builds on the state-of-The-Art pretrained deep language model, BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), with new convolutional net and named entity recognition (NER) layers for extracting attribute, description, and sentiment words from online user review corpora. The machine translation algorithm BLEU (BiLingual Evaluation Understudy) is utilized to extract need expressions in the form of predefined part-of-speech combinations (e.g., adjective-noun, verb-noun). Numerical experiments are conducted on a large dataset scraped from a major e-commerce retail store for apparel and footwear to demonstrate the performance, feasibility, and potentials of the developed methodology. © 2020 Royal Society of Chemistry. All rights reserved.”

Nevertheless challenges such as different styles of writing, use of negation and sarcasm, existence of spelling mistakes, invention of new words etc. provide obstacle in the correct classification of sentiments. This paper provides an ensemble of classifiers framework for sentiment analysis. The proposed weighted majority voting ensemble method combines six models including Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression, Stochastic Gradient Descent, Random Forest, Decision Tree and Support Vector Machine to form a single classifier. Weights of the individual classifiers of the ensemble are chosen as accuracy or Fl-score by optimizing their performance. This approach combines models based on the simple majority voting as opposed to the one based on weighted majority voting. Additionally, a comparison is drawn among these six individual classifiers to evaluate their performance. The proposed ensemble model is tested on some existing sentiment datasets, including SemEval 2017 Task 4A, 4B and 4C. The results demonstrate that the Logistic Regression classifier is optimal as compared to other individual classifiers. Furthermore, the proposed ensemble weighted majority voting classifier with the six individual classifiers performs better compared to the simple majority voting and all independent classifiers. © 2020 IEEE.”

INTRODUCTION
Due to the popularity of social media, social psychology researchers have long been interested in exploring the psychological factors linked to the use of these platforms. Most research in this space has examined older platforms like Facebook or Instagram. For our research project, we focused on TikTok, a relatively new social media platform on which people create and share short videos for others to consume. People post a wide variety of content on the platform, including dance challenges, comedy skits, educational content, or brief glimpses into their lives. Working together as a cohort, we brainstormed a range of variables that could theoretically be linked to TikTok consumption. We then administered a survey to a large sample of people to test these hypothesised relationships. The variables we measured as correlates of TikTok consumption were:

•	Extraversion 
•	Agreeableness 
•	Conscientiousness 
•	Neuroticism 
•	Openness to Experience 
•	Sensation Seeking 
•	Empathy 
•	Narcissism 
•	Materialism 
•	Social Comparison Orientation 
•	Fear of Missing Out 
•	Sense of Belonging 
•	Loneliness 
•	Self-Esteem 
•	Body Satisfaction 
•	Life Satisfaction 
•	Social Anxiety 
•	Depressive Symptoms 
•	Descriptive Norms 
•	Injunctive Norms


Your task is to choose two of the above variables and write up a research report investigating the relationship between these variables and TikTok consumption. You will submit this research report for assessment. This assignment will be intensive and will require work throughout semester. The assignment will be systematically covered in the tutorial materials, which will be made available to you progressively throughout semester. Tutors will be available in tutorials to answer questions and guide you with the assignment.


RESEARCH
To write your research report (especially Introduction & Discussion sections), you will need to do your own independent research to find articles relevant to each of the two hypotheses you make about the relationship between your two chosen variables and TikTok consumption. First, find literature to help you understand each of your chosen variables and how they are defined. Then, find literature examining the relationship between your chosen variables and TikTok consumption. It is OK to use literature examining the relationship between your chosen variables and other social media platforms too – when literature on a particular research question is scarce, you should try to find tangential evidence on related variables to inform your hypotheses. You can use broader theory-driven arguments to inform your hypotheses as well. This is all especially important when there is not much existing evidence for your chosen variable and its relationship with TikTok consumption. Some of the research articles you find may be statistically complex. Don’t panic – you don’t need to know the statistics that they use. Try reading through the abstract, introduction, and discussion of these articles to get an idea of what relationships they predicted and what they found. When reading through these research articles, ignore information that is irrelevant to your own research questions/hypotheses. This researched literature should be consistently cited in your research report. Statements made throughout the report should be backed up with a citation. Use Google Scholar in conjunction with UQ Library to find articles. 
•	Search for key terms both apart and together (e.g. “extraversion”, “TikTok”) 
•	Using multiple variations of words or related concepts may yield more results (e.g. “body satisfaction” vs. “body image”, “TikTok” vs. “social media”) 
•	Try both US and UK spellings (e.g. “behavior” vs. “behaviour”)

Results – included in word count (except for Table)

Dentro del proceso de aprendizaje hay una metodología descrita como “significativa”, la cual se
puede definir como aquella que permite construir su propio aprendizaje dotado de significado. A
partir de dicha teoría, la estructura cognitiva (saberes previos en determinado campo), entra en
una relación directa con la nueva información que adquiere el/la estudiante, esto con el fin de
estructurar conocimientos desde un papel activo-participativo y no desde lo abstracto como se
puede llegar a percibir.
“David Paul Ausubel fue un psicólogo estadounidense cuya contribución más significativa los
ejerció en los campos de la psicología de la educación, la psicología cognitiva, el aprendizaje y el
desarrollo, investigando sobre cómo se organiza nuestro aprendizaje y los avances significativos en
él. Bajo la influencia de Jean Piaget, Ausubel creía que la comprensión de conceptos, principios e
ideas se logran a través del razonamiento deductivo. Del mismo modo, creía en la idea del
aprendizaje significativo en lugar de la memorización. En el prefacio de su libro “Psicología de la
Educación: Un punto de vista cognoscitivo”, dice:
“El factor más importante que influye en el aprendizaje, es lo que el alumno ya sabe. Determinar
esto y enseñarle en consecuencia» (Ausubel, 1968)”
1

Para las sesiones del pre-ICFES, es utilizado el mecanismo de aprendizaje por recepción, el cual se
utiliza para adquirir y almacenar ideas e información de cualquier campo del conocimiento. Dicho
enfoque tiene características propias que son empleadas durante el proceso de enseñanza de
pensamiento social:
a) Presentar la información al estudiante como debe ser aprendida, en su forma final (recepción).
b) Presentar temas usando y aprovechando los esquemas previos del estudiante.
c) Dar cierta información al estudiante provocando que éste por sí mismo descubra un
conocimiento nuevo (descubrimiento).
d) Proveer información, contenidos, temas importantes y útiles que den como resultado ideas
nuevas en el/la estudiante.
e) Mostrar materiales pedagógicos de forma coloquial y organizada que no distraigan la
concentración del estudiante.
f) Hacer que haya una participación activa por parte del estudiante."

@bot.command()
async def dick(ctx):
    with open("dk.txt", "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
        # Проверка есть ли пользователь в dk.txt
    if str(ctx.author.id) not in data:
        data[str(ctx.author.id)] = {"dk": 0, "last_used": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")}
    else:
        # Прововеряет когда пользователь последний раз использовал команду
        last_used = datetime.strptime(data[str(ctx.author.id)]["last_used"], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        if last_used + timedelta(hours=8) > datetime.now():
            time_left = last_used + timedelta(hours=8) - datetime.now()
            await ctx.send(f"Ты уже использовал данную команду. Твой писюн {data[str(ctx.author.id)]['dk']} см")
            return
        # Рандом
    data[str(ctx.author.id)]["last_used"] = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    with open("dk.txt", "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f)
    roll = random.randint(-5, 10)
    while roll == 0:
        roll = random.randint(-5, 10)
    data[str(ctx.author.id)]["dk"] += roll
    with open("dk.txt", "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f)
        # Эмбед
    if roll > 0:
        message = "Ваш писюн увеличился на {} см. Сейчас длина Вашего писюна составляет {} см.".format(roll, data[str(ctx.author.id)]["dk"])
    elif roll < 0:
        message = "Ваш писюн уменьшился на {} см. Сейчас длина Вашего писюна составляет {} см.".format(abs(roll), data[str(ctx.author.id)]["dk"])
    Embed = discord.Embed(title="DK", description=message)
    await ctx.send(embed=Embed)

# Серверный топ
@bot.command()
async def top(ctx):
    with open("dk.txt", "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    members_on_server = [member.id for member in ctx.guild.members]
    top_dk = [item for item in sorted(data.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["dk"], reverse=True) if int(item[0]) in members_on_server][:15]
    top_dk_str = '\n'.join(['{}. {} = {} см'.format(i+1, ctx.guild.get_member(int(x[0])).display_name.split("#")[0], x[1]["dk"]) for i, x in enumerate(top_dk)])
    embed = discord.Embed(title="Топ Дик", description=top_dk_str)
    await ctx.send(embed=embed)

# Личная статистика пользователя(Доделать если не лень)
@bot.command()
async def stats(ctx):
    with open("dk.txt", "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    
    # Сортировка всех игроков по их сантиметрам
    all_players = sorted(data.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["dk"], reverse=True)
    
    # Тут ищется первое место и место пользователя в глобальном топе
    user_id = str(ctx.author.id)
    for i, (player_id, player_data) in enumerate(all_players):
        if player_id == user_id:
            global_rank = i + 1
            user_dk = player_data["dk"]
            break
    else:
        return await ctx.send("Твоя статистика:")
    
    # Тут ебаная математика нахуй
    first_place_dk = all_players[0][1]["dk"]
    dk_difference = first_place_dk - user_dk
    
    # Сортировка игроков по сантиметрам на сервере
    server_players = [(ctx.guild.get_member(int(player_id)), player_data) for player_id, player_data in data.items() if ctx.guild.get_member(int(player_id))]
    server_players = sorted(server_players, key=lambda x: x[1]["dk"], reverse=True)
    
    # Тута ищется место игрока в топе сервера
    for i, (player, player_data) in enumerate(server_players):
        if player.id == ctx.author.id:
            server_rank = i + 1
            break
    
    # Эмбед
    embed = discord.Embed(title="Status", description="Твоя статистика:", color=0x8b00ff)
    embed.add_field(name="Глобал топ", value=global_rank, inline=True)
    embed.add_field(name="Сантиметры", value=user_dk, inline=True)
    embed.add_field(name="Осталось до №1", value=dk_difference, inline=True)
    embed.add_field(name="Сервер топ", value=server_rank, inline=True)
    
    await ctx.send(embed=embed)

1.1 Маркетинг
Маркетинг является процессом планирования, организации и реализации продукции или услуг, удовлетворяющих потребности потребителей. Маркетинговые исследования позволяют определить потребности и предпочтения потребителей, а также принять решения о том, какие товары и услуги необходимо производить и продавать.

1.2 Логистика
Логистика является процессом планирования, координации и контроля со стороны предприятия, направленным на доставку продукции с минимальными затратами и максимальной эффективностью. Логистика играет важную роль в цепи поставок, обеспечивая своевременную и качественную доставку товаров.

2 глава – Влияние маркетинга и логистики на закупочную деятельность 
2.1 Влияние маркетинга на закупочную деятельность

2.2 Влияние логистики на закупочную деятельность
Логистика играет важную роль в закупочной деятельности, так как она обеспечивает своевременную доставку товаров и услуг. Кроме того, логистический анализ помогает определить наиболее эффективные и экономичные способы доставки товаров, что ведет к снижению затрат на закупки.

3 глава – Анализ закупочной деятельности на примере предприятия «КАКОГО???»

The main contribution of this paper is to introduce a new stacking machine learning model for cryptocurrency volatility forecasting. The model incorporates different volatility measures that may capture the unique characteristics of cryptocurrencies. In addition, we use a combination of different regression and classification methods to forecast both the magnitude and change direction of cryptocurrency volatility.
Our model builds on the existing literature on cryptocurrency volatility forecasting by incorporating a range of regression and classification methods. By stacking multiple models, we are able to improve the accuracy and robustness of our predictions. Moreover, the use of different volatility measures helps to capture the idiosyncratic nature of cryptocurrency markets, which differ from traditional financial markets in several ways.
Our approach has several practical applications for investors and financial institutions. The ability to forecast cryptocurrency volatility with greater accuracy can help investors to make more informed investment decisions and to manage their risk exposure more effectively. Moreover, our model can be used by financial institutions to develop hedging strategies and to manage their overall exposure to cryptocurrency markets.

The current research provide different contributions in the literature of volatility and VaR forecasting, including:
	This research proposes a new approach to VaR prediction using stacking machine learning models. The final model combines the predictions from multiple base models, taking into account their individual predictions to improve overall performance.
	Due to highly volatile nature of Bitcoin returns, most of the volatility forecasting (and especially) VaR forecasting research is based on less volatile markets like stock market. However, we provide models to cope with the high complexity task of volatility and VaR forecasting in Bitcoin market.

I am writing a case report for a medical journal. I want you to help me write a conclusion paragraph based on the following information presented below:

ABSTRACT: Extramammary Paget's Disease (EMPD) is an intra-epithelial malignancy that primarily occurs where apocrine sweat glands are located. It is associated with invasive adenocarcinoma components and other secondary cancers such as colon or rectal cancers, which can occur due to the proximity of EMPD to apocrine glands near the genitals. Clinical presentations of EMPD are often demarcated plaques that appear as erosive, ulcerated, or scaly on the vulva, perineal, scrotal, perianal, and penile skin. This case report describes a 75-year-old male patient with a history of basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma, colon cancer, and bladder cancer, who had recurring EMPD near his scrotum. The patient had a wide local excision to treat his first EMPD case, followed by Mohs micrographic surgery (MMS) 10 years later when his second EMPD case developed. Two surgical attempts were made to reduce the growth of EMPD, which responded well to MMS. Since his EMPD mostly resolved, the patient was prescribed Imiquimod Aldara 5% topical cream while monitoring for colon and bladder cancer. Although the patient had a quick recovery after the recent MMS, precautionary steps still need to be taken to minimize or halt the progression of EMPD or other related cancers. The patient's EMPD manifests as a rash that involves the anogenital skin, which may be associated with an underlying gastrointestinal or prostate malignancy. Recurrence of EMPD is common in the first two years, and the prognosis is good if the disease is localized, and there is no other underlying associated cancer. EMPD is better treated with MMS than WLE. Slow MMS should be the golden standard for treating such aggressive conditions as EMPD. The patient is being referred to gastroenterology to rule out occult malignancy.

KEYWORDS: Extra Mammary Paget’s Disease, Mohs Surgery, Wide Local Excision, Case Report, (Redeveloped EMPD?), 

Case Report
INTRODUCTION: Extramammary Paget’s Disease (EMPD) is classified as an intra-epithelial malignancy that occurs most prominently where apocrine sweat glands are located [1]. This dermatological condition is associated with an invasive adenocarcinoma component as well as other secondary cancers, such as colon or rectal cancers due to its proximity to apocrine glands near the genitals [2]. Clinical presentations of EMPD are often found on the vulva, although perineal, scrotal, perianal, and penile skin, and are often demarcated plaques that perceive as erosive, ulcerated, or scaly in presentation [1].
In this case report, we describe a case of recurring EMPD on the left inguinal crease, near the scrotum, resulting in scarred bumps. The patient had a wide local excision (WLE) to treat his first EMPD case. Roughly 10 years later, his second case of EMPD was resolved with Mohs micrographic surgery (MMS). Two surgical attempts were taken to help reduce the growth and treat the patient’s EMPD. Although the patient has had a quick recovery after the recent MMS, precautionary steps still need to be taken to minimize or halt the progression of EMPD or other related cancers.

REPORT OF A CASE: A 75-year-old male patient has had recurring EMPD and extensive history of basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma, colon cancer, and bladder cancer. Since age 32, the patient has had roughly over 90 incisions for treating his various cancers. Upon reviewing the patient's medical history, he is noted to have had bladder cancer and colon polyps 12 years ago. It is noted that the colon is a rare site of origin for distant bladder metastasis. Shortly after his polypectomy, the patient developed EMPD near his scrotum. Though a direct correlation between his metastasis cannot be concluded, there is a high chance that his bladder cancer developed in his first case of EMPD, first noted to be in 2011. Urology, at Mayo Clinic, performed his WLE in his first case of EMPD in addition to performing his polypectomy. From 2011 to 2021, the patient’s EMPD had resolved and he has followed up with regular cytoscopies.
On October 2021, the patient presented to our clinic with a chief complaint of redeveloped EMPD in the same region again around his scrotum (Figure 1). This patient’s EMPD manifests with multiple, evenly-spaced erythematous purpuric papules that involve the anogenital skin. Pathology confirmed the diagnosis of EMPD. The patient’s condition started to metastasize around his scrotum around January 2022. Since this developed pathophysiology was noted, nearly a decade later from his first surgery, the patient was referred to the dermatology department of the Mayo Clinic. 
On February 2022, MMS was performed again at the left inguinal crease covering around his scrotum (Figures 2 and 3). The surgery provided immediate relief to the patient and on May 4th, 2022, Imiquimod Aldara 5% topical cream was prescribed to the groin while monitoring colon and bladder cancer. Upon the advice of the patient's urologist, the patient did not take the Imiquimod due to prostate cancer a month prior.
This type of EMPD may be associated with an underlying gastrointestinal or prostate malignancy. Though his EMPD condition is mostly resolved, he is being referred to gastroenterology to rule out occult malignancy.

DISCUSSION: Recurrence for EMPD is common in the first two years and the prognosis is good if the disease is localized and there is no other underlying associated cancer [3]. It is rare for patients to have invasive and metastatic EMPD and exhibit a poor prognosis, even when there is a good response to a first chemotherapy line [3]. Since this patient had recurring EMPD after a ten-year time frame near his scrotum, he is still potentially at risk for redeveloping the condition in the future, especially considering his vast history of various cancers.
The patient’s first case was surgically removed through a WLE in 2011, which is not the ideal way to treat EMPD; MMS is better for treating patients with EMPD [4,5]. However, the golden standard for treating patients with such an aggressive condition as EMPD should be to perform slow MMS [6]. Additionally, the patient did not have any chemotherapy done for his first case of EMPD because the urology department performed a WLE instead of what the dermatology department would have done, through MMS. Chemotherapy was also not done for his second case of EMPD as well because it was not the golden standard, compared to performing MMS. Imiquimod Aldara 5% topical cream, was given to this patient to manage his EMPD, however, since the patient had prostate cancer surgery right before his subscription, he was advised to not apply Imiquimod to his groin [7].
Since MMS was performed in his second clinical presentation of EMPD in 2022, there is a good chance that the patient’s EMPD is fully resolved. If MMS, specifically slow MMS, was performed instead of Urology performing the WLE, the patient might have not had EMPD recurrence [6]. Furthermore, slow MMS would have been a better treatment regime for the second case instead of normal MMS and could have led to more accurate excisions, leading to better removal of EMPD [8].
Since this patient has had colon and bladder cancer in the past, we want to make sure that any cancers, if developed, are detected early as treatment options may be less invasive in nature if found earlier, especially since this patient has a history of cancers near the anogenital region; therefore, this patient must be monitored not only for EMPD, but also for bladder cancer, colon cancer, and basal & squamous cell carcinoma [9]. Patients like this should be planning to get a cystoscopy to check for bladder cancer and a colonoscopy for their ruling out gastrointestinal-related cancers and check roughly every three months, even if their EMPD condition is resolved [1,9].

were those patients who were physicians or resided in health-care facilities and whose health status was therefore monitored according to a different protocol.
Routine Monitoring Process
In the present system of veteran care, each veteran has a corresponding general physician. Each
general physician is responsible for five veterans, and oversees their health surveys according
to ICD-10 coding. The survey includes the general physician’s visits, specialist referrals and consultation information (when referred by the general
physician), as well as laboratory tests and imaging
in order to confirm a suspected diagnosis. Routine
monitoring was done each month by the general
physicians. Telephone calls were also used to follow up on medical complications as reported by
the patients. The results of the routine monthly scheduled visits by the general physicians were
recorded. The visits included 20- to 30-min interviews, including a physical examination, followed
by laboratory assessment, distribution of prescriptions and individualized specialist consultations
for each patient. To ensure complete care for all
veterans, routine visits were conducted in the patient’s living quarters in cases of limited mobility
or the veteran’s preference. The annual incidence
of certain ICD-10-defined medical conditions was
derived from the records of the corresponding
general physician for each veteran.
Telephone Survey
A telephone survey was performed to assess
patients’ health-related complaints and any new
diagnoses during January and February of 2010.
Successful calls were made to 125 veterans based
on randomization of their ID numbers. During
the calls veterans were asked about complaints regarding their health status via open-ended questions. Patients were asked what their major health
complaints are; then they were asked if additional medical problems or concerns had developed
since their most recent follow-up with their primary care physician.
Additional Data-Gathering
Outings
In addition to the monitoring, 21 recreational
outings including educational, medical and cultural programs were held for 600 veterans and 1800
of their family members, which provided a further
opportunity to gather health information. Patients
with a common medical status were included on
each trip so that specific educational programs for
their level and type of injury could be provided.
Complications & Complaints of Veterans with SCI 271
Statistical Analysis
A descriptive statistical analysis was performed, including evaluations of the level of injury, medical complications (as ICD-10 codes), subjectively reported medical complaints, mortality
statistics and causes of death. Microsoft Excel (Microsoft Office – 2007) and SPSS software (Version
13 – 2004) were used for the analysis.
In conducting this study the applicable institutional or governmental regulations concerning
the ethical use of human volunteers were followed
during the course of this research.
Results
The total number of Iranian SCI veterans of
the Iraq-Iran war was 1984: 34 females (1.71%)
and 1950 males (98.29%), according to the Iranian national database. In the health-monitoring
study complete records were available for 1506,
1684 and 1803 SCI patients for the years 2007,
2008 and 2009 respectively. The median year of
birth of the SCI veterans was 1964. The mean age
was 46 ± 6.68 by the year 2010. A total of 1873 patients (94.40%) were married. The causes of injury were bullets and shrapnel, road traffic accidents
and city bombardments. Table 1 reveals the distribution of the spinal cord injury levels. Classifying the participants using the American Spinal Injury Association (ASIA) Impairment Scale (AIS),
the majority were ASIA A (complete SPI with no
motor or sensory function preserved in the sacral
segment). Only 174 (8.77%) had incomplete injuries (not separately defined on other ASIA impairment scales).
Monitoring was carried out for three consecutive years, from March 20, 2007, to March 19, 2010.
Table 2 shows descriptive data on the health-related status of the participants, obtained from the
general physicians’ monthly visits. Table 3 presents the data from successful telephone calls addressing the self-reported complaints of SCI veterans. The most frequent complaint in the telephone
survey was related to kidney and/or urologic disorders, while pressure ulcers were the most frequent
problem reported in interviews during the physicians’ monitoring process.
The monitoring and follow-up were carried out
with veterans who suffered SCI during the eightyear period of the Iraq-Iran War (1980–1988) abd
whose injuries had lasted between 23 to 31 years
(median of 27 years). A total of 101 SCI veterans among the 1984 records died between 2000
and 2010, prior to the conclusion of this study. By
March 2010, out of a total of 1984 veterans, 1803
(90.88%) were included in follow-up monitoring,
101 (5.09%) had died, and 77 (3.88%) were lost to
follow up. The causes and numbers of death are
shown in Tables 4 and 5. Among the deceased veterans, the mean duration of injury (in years) was
16.27 for cervical-level injuries, 24.71 for thoraciclevel injuries and 22.00 for lumbar-level injuries."

бы получить нестандартную конструкцию, обеспечивающую возможность 
синхронизации ее с линзой в отношении центрирования и регулирования 
стандартных значений параметров, определяющих положение линзы в оправе 
(вертексное расстояние, пантоскопический угол наклона оправы и др.). С учетом 
проведенных исследований был разработан проект оправы с функциональным 
использованием заушников и носового упора, при этом конструкция последнего 
и его положение были существенно изменены. Ноу-хау, касающиеся 
4
предлагаемой конструкции деталей и узлов оправы. При изготовление очков с 
однофокальными и прогрессивными линзами, с применением оправы 
разработанной конструкции используется принципиально иной подход к 
центрированию линзы; оптический центр линзы, центр зрачка и центр окуляра 
совмещаются путем перемещения крепежного стержня 1 каждого окуляра в 
соединительной втулке 2 по горизонтали. При этом важно подобрать 
оптимальный диаметр линзы. Регулирование пантоскопического угла наклона 
оправы и вертексного расстояния происходит за счет изменения соединительной 
детали заушников. Таким образом, убеждены ООО «Оптика-Центр», ими было 
найдено нестандартное техническое решение конструкции деталей оправы, 
обеспечивающее синхронность центрирования линз при ассиметричном 
положении глаз и снижение до минимума призматического эффекта и 
астигматизма. 
Основными новшествами в области материалов очковых линз является 
показатель преломления материала, из которого изготовлены линзы. Высокий 
показатель преломления позволяет получать более тонкие и легкие линзы. А 
именно такие эстетичные и комфортные линзы максимально отвечают 
современному потребительскому спросу. Бурное развитие органических 
материалов привело к созданию в последние годы оптических пластмасс с 
показателем преломления выше 1,7(и при этом с достаточно высоким числом 
Аббе). Одной из первых использовала высокопреломляющий полимер японская 
компания Ноуа, предложившая линзы серии Teslalid 1,71.В настоящее время уже 
несколько компаний выпускают органические линзы с показателем преломления 
1,74: Essilor (Fusio 1,74], Seiko, Rodenstock [Cosmolit 1,74) и многие другие 
фирмы. Эти линзы, особенно в сочетании с асферическим дизайном, на 
сегодняшний день самые тонкие и плоские, к тому же они очень легкие.
К сожалению, некоторые оптические и механические свойства
высокопреломляющих материалов далеки от идеальных. Поэтому ведутся 
исследования по разработке новых материалов, которые обладали бы 
оптимальным сочетанием различных свойств. В последнее время активно 
5
рекламируются линзы из нового материала Trivex (разработка компании PPG), 
отличающегося довольно удачной комбинацией оптических и физических 
свойств. Отметим, что по ударопрочности Trivex равен поликарбонату, но у 
Trivex несколько лучше другие характеристики. Например, больше число Аббе 
(43^46), меньше плотность (1,1). Кроме того, Trivex совместим с различными 
видами покрытий, и допускает обработку линз из него на стандартном 
оборудовании; он отлично подходит для линз, устанавливаемых в оправы на 
винтах. Так что в перспективе Trivex вполне способен потеснить на рынке 
очковых линз поликарбонат, который широко применяется для изготовления линз 
повышенной ударопрочности. В настоящее время Trivex применяется для 
изготовления линз фирмами Ноуа [линзы Phoenix), Younger Optics (линзы Trilogy) 
и Thai Polymer Lens Co. (линзы Excelite TVX).
Органические линзы, особенно из высокопреломляющих полимеров, 
требуют нанесения упрочняющих покрытий для предохранения поверхности 
линзы от образования царапин. Линзы с просветляющими покрытиями не только 
выглядят более эстетично, но и обеспечивают пользователю более высокое 
качество зрения и зрительный комфорт. Поэтому технология нанесения на 
очковые линзы различных покрытий интенсивно развивается, и в настоящее 
время все крупные производители линз имеют свои фирменные покрытия, 
улучшающие оптические и механические свойства линз. Причем все чаще 
применяются многофункциональные покрытия, сочетающие в себе несколько 
просветляющих слоев с упрочняющим слоем. Последние новинки в этой области 
связаны с применением дополнительного верхнего слоя, который не только 
придает поверхности водо- и грязеотталкивающие свойства, но и уменьшает 
электростатический заряд поверхности линзы, в результате чего к линзе меньше 
притягиваются загрязняющие частицы. Кроме того, дополнительная обработка 
делает поверхность линзы более гладкой, что значительно облегчает процесс ее 
очистки от загрязнений. Некоторые фирмы, рекламируя достоинства своих 
покрытий, отмечают уменьшение степени запотевания линз прирезкой смене 
температуры. Это неудобство испытывают пользователи очками, когда, например, 
6
в холодную погоду входят с улицы в теплое помещение. Последними новинками 
оптического рынка стали фирменные многофункциональные покрытия Teflon 
Easycare (компания Sola), Crizal Forte(компания Essilor) и LotuTec (компания 
Zeiss).
С появлением в 1990 г. первых линз Transitions пользователи очками 
получили возможность обходиться одной парой очков и в помещении, и на ярком 
солнце. Сейчас фотохромные линзы стали очень популярны, а разработанная 
компанией Transitions технология придания органическим линзам фотохромных 
свойств широко применяется ведущими производителями линз. Особенность 
технологии Transitions состоит в том, что фотохромный агент в процессе 
обработки проникает внутрь линзы на глубину 100-150 мкм, создавая в линзе 
фотохромный слой одинаковой толщины. Поэтому все линзы Transitions на 
солнце имеют равномерную окраску по всей поверхности независимо от степени 
рефракции. Достоинством технологии Transitions является ее совместимость с 
различными органическими материалами с показателем преломления от 1,5 до 
1,67, включая поликарбонаты Trivex. Последнее поколение линз Transitions, 
известное как Next Generation Transitions, имеет коэффициент пропускания в 
неактивированном состоянии 92% [а с просветляющим покрытием до99%), очень 
быстро темнеет [за 15с коэффициент светопропускания снижается до 30%), кроме 
того, фотохромные свойства этих линз слабее зависят от температуры, чем 
фотохромные характеристики предыдущих поколений Transitions.

import os
import requests
import urllib.parse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# 设置要下载的页面 URL 和图片存储的目录（可以修改为你自己的目录）
image_dir = 'F:/BC'
url = 'https://brickvisual.com/'

# 创建图片存储目录
if not os.path.exists(image_dir):
    os.makedirs(image_dir)

# 下载页面中的所有图片
response = requests.get(url)
soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')

for img in soup.find_all('img'):
    # 获取图片的 URL
    img_url = img['src']

    # 如果图片 URL 是 data URI 或不是以 https:// 开头，则跳过
    if img_url.startswith('data:image/') or not img_url.startswith('https://'):
        continue

    # 如果图片 URL 以 / 开头，则拼接 base url
    if img_url.startswith('/'):
        img_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(url, img_url)

    # 发送 GET 请求获取图片内容
    img_response = requests.get(img_url)

    # 过滤掉小于 100KB 的图片
    if len(img_response.content) < 100 * 1024:
        continue

    # 获取图片的文件名
    img_filename = img_url.split('/')[-1]

    # 拼接出图片的完整路径，然后保存图片
    img_path = os.path.join(image_dir, img_filename)

Truth is usually held to be the opposite of falsehood. The concept of truth is discussed and debated in various contexts, including philosophy, art, theology, and science. Most human activities depend upon the concept, where its nature as a concept is assumed rather than being a subject of discussion; these include most of the sciences, law, journalism, and everyday life. Some philosophers view the concept of truth as basic, and unable to be explained in any terms that are more easily understood than the concept of truth itself.[2] Most commonly, truth is viewed as the correspondence of language or thought to a mind-independent world. This is called the correspondence theory of truth.

Various theories and views of truth continue to be debated among scholars, philosophers, and theologians.[2][3] There are many different questions about the nature of truth which are still the subject of contemporary debates, such as: the question of defining truth. If it is even possible to give an informative definition of truth. Identifying things are truth-bearers and are therefore capable of being true or false. If truth and falsehood are bivalent, or if there are other truth values. Identifying the criteria of truth that allow us to identify it and to distinguish it from falsehood. Core setting:

In the time before time, the land of Hyrule was bathed in the light of the three golden goddesses: Din, Nayru, and Farore. These divine beings dedicated themselves to creating a balanced world, filled with beauty, wisdom, and strength. Upon completing their great work, the goddesses decided to leave a lasting symbol of their presence and the essence of their powers: the Triforce.

The divine architects of creation believed that the Triforce would serve as a sacred relic guiding the people of Hyrule toward a path of balance and prosperity. However, their intervention and confluence of their divine powers resulted in an unforeseen outcome: the creation of imperfect, double-edged blessings.

Din, the goddess of power, imbued the Triforce of Power with her fiery strength and a fierce determination to protect the ones they love. Nayru, the goddess of wisdom, granted the Triforce of Wisdom with her profound intellect and foresight, allowing the wielder to anticipate and navigate the challenges they faced. Farore, the goddess of courage, gifted the Triforce of Courage with her indomitable bravery, inspiring warriors to face the darkest of fears and the most daunting of challenges.

Though crafted with noble intentions, the fusion of the three divine essences birthed unforeseen curses within each blessing. What was meant to be a gift that would unite and uplift the people of Hyrule ultimately transformed into a symbol of strife, temptation, and suffering.

The gods, in their wisdom and desire to foster balance in the world, understood that perfection was an unattainable ideal, and that power, wisdom, and courage could not exist without adversity and struggle. Hence, they bestowed upon the people of Hyrule these flawed blessings, hoping that they would serve as a humble reminder of the complexity and duality of existence.

The mythos of the Triforce and its consequences would be etched into the history of Hyrule, acting as a testament to the imperfect nature of creation and the importance of finding balance amidst the constant fluctuation of fortune and despair. Through this sacred relic, the people of Hyrule would learn the harsh lesson that blessings and curses are often two sides of the same coin, and that the relentless pursuit of power, wisdom, and courage comes with its respective burdens and consequences.
